_readme: The starter skills install.js copies into a new Hub. They come from the free claude_skills pack at the commit in ref, never from a copy kept in this repo. skills/README.md explains each one and how to move the pin.
_ref: A commit, not a tag. A tag can be moved to point at different files later; a commit id cannot, so everyone who installs this version gets exactly the same skills. Moving the pin is a one-line change here, reviewed like any other.

skills.name: handoff
skills.why: Closes a session into a note the next session, or another computer, picks up: how work moves between sessions and machines.

skills.name: file-organizer
skills.why: Sorts Downloads and 00-Inbox into the Hub's zones. It shows the plan first and never deletes.

skills.name: claude-md-doctor
skills.why: Keeps the Hub's CLAUDE.md and each project's short and checkable, so every session follows them.

skills.name: systems-map
skills.why: Maps a project's parts and what depends on what: how Claude finds its way around inside a codebase.

skills.name: backlog
skills.why: One place for the work you have not done yet.

skills.name: work-orders
skills.why: Works through that backlog, one order at a time, with helpers.

skills.name: quick-design
skills.why: A short plan before a change, so the change is the one you meant.

skills.name: scope-check
skills.why: Checks the work matched the plan: the question a gate asks before anything merges.

skills.name: smoke-check
skills.why: A two-minute "is it still working?" before you merge.

skills.name: notetaker
skills.why: Notes every future session can find, so you stop explaining the same thing twice.

skills.name: quick-research
skills.why: Answers a question with sources, in one sitting.

skills.name: prompt-coach
skills.why: Teaches you to ask Claude for things well, with your own prompts as the examples.
